title: CFA Society Economic Update - Convening an External Audience
situation: As a member of the CFA Society Toronto Corporate Finance Committee, I took on organizing an economic update event for the membership.
obstacle: Securing a keynote of real standing required a direct ask to a senior chief economist with no obligation to accept, and the event had to justify the attention of a professional audience.
actions: Organized an economic update event for the CFA Society Toronto Corporate Finance Committee
Secured a leading Canadian chief economist as keynote speaker
Managed the format, programming, and delivery of the event
results: Delivered an economic update event to the CFA Society Toronto membership
Built a direct professional relationship with the keynote economist that later supported work inside the firm
fullStory: On the CFA Society Toronto Corporate Finance Committee I organized an economic update event and secured a leading Canadian chief economist as the keynote. Committee membership ran 2017 to 2022. The relationship built through that event carried into work inside the firm afterward.
